title: Art. 2.2.1 — Annex 18 - The Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air, Chapter 2 - Applicability, 2.2 Dangerous Goods Technical Instructions, 2.2.1
content: Each Contracting State shall take the necessary measures to achieve compliance with the detailed provisions contained in the Technical Instructions. Each Contracting State shall also take the necessary measures to achieve compliance with any amendment to the Technical Instructions which may be published during the specified period of applicability of an edition of the Technical Instructions.
